problem_statement: Add event_timeout_is_pending(const event_timeout_t *event_timeout) to the event timeout API. It must return true when an event_timeout is scheduled to be delivered, either because its timeout is still pending or because its event has already been queued, and return false when neither condition holds. In particular, after event_timeout_set() it must report pending, and after event_timeout_clear() it must report not pending.
